findings.text: The Dispatcher's task builder lost the `page` skill. `Servex/agents/Dispatcher.js:134` still spawns `role: "task-mastermind"`, which now resolves to the `mastermind` row (`roles.js:54`). That row has no `skills: ["page"]`, which the deleted `task-mastermind` row carried. So every queued page task now starts without the page rules. Fix: switch the Dispatcher to `page-mastermind` (it keeps `page`), or add `skills: ["page"]` to that spawn.

`public/framework/ai/doc/agent-context.md:12` is stale. It still says `task-mastermind` is manager/medium with skills `sub-mastermind` + `page`; it is now the `mastermind` row (architect, high, no skills). Line 16 also still names skill `sub-mastermind` for `directory-mastermind`. `public/framework/ai/doc/models.md:34` still lists "task-mastermind … `manager` / medium". These are the "readmes match the code" part of Done.

The moved long-form doc has broken links. `Servex/agents/doc/task-mastermind-long-form.md:1` still calls itself the "Role readme for `task-mastermind`", and `:31` links `[mastermind.md](mastermind.md)`. From `doc/` that link is now a 404; it should be `../roles/mastermind.md`. The doc is also missing from `Servex/agents/readme.md`; only `mastermind.md` and findings.md link it (law 10).

`Servex/agents/roles/readme.md:18` gives the `page-mastermind`/`directory-mastermind` row "manager (Sonnet, medium)". That is still true for those two rows. But the table now has no line for the old `task-mastermind` word, which spawns architect/high. Add one clause saying the alias words get the `mastermind` row's architect/high, so a reader doesn't assume the old cost.

`page-mastermind` and `directory-mastermind` now inline the whole `mastermind.md` (7,566 words, the executive's budget and spawning rules) instead of the 2,432-word task text. The `directory-mastermind` is a plan-mode question answerer, so it now carries the most text and the least fitting role. A one-task readme, or the short section alone, would be cheaper.

The steering text is gone (`session-smart.md:3` now says Claude is the default; `OR_ONLY` and `OR_MODEL` are removed; `VOICE_MODELS` no longer exists). One automatic flip remains: `Servex/agents/Sessions.js:327` writes `session-backend.txt = openrouter` when Claude refuses one voice session. The voice seats then stay on OpenRouter until someone runs `--backend anthropic`. findings.md records it as kept, but it is the same "left over from a night the tokens ran out" pattern the owner asked to sweep. Consider expiring it, or say so in findings.md as a keep with a reason the owner would accept.

The `SERVEX_OPENROUTER_PAUSED` default flipped from on to off (`Agents.js:80`). The comment above it already said so, and an explicit `/` model now works as item 1 asks. But the error message on line 81 still says "set SERVEX_OPENROUTER_PAUSED=0 to allow", which is wrong now (unset it, or set anything but 1).
Tests: every `Servex/agents/*.test.mjs` passes in the worktree except `prompt-tasks.test.mjs`. That one fails on the main tree too, so it predates this change, as findings.md says.
Whether a fresh agent can continue: yes. findings.md, the commit `c5b4f2a49` and task.jsonl say what was done. The task.jsonl has no landing or decision lines yet, though (the last line is `commit`).
